description: 鹿児島県津波災害警戒区域 [tsunami and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 鹿児島県. 津波防災地域づくりに関する法律に基づき指定した津波災害警戒区域図. Coverage: 鹿児島県. The portal files it under the publisher 鹿児島県. Its tags are イエローゾーン, 志布志市, 津波災害警戒, 海岸. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2023-03-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
